content.title: Builders Are Offering Mortgage-Rate Discounts. Home Buyers Aren’t Biting.
content.summary: D.R. Horton  which builds roughly one in every seven new homes in the U.S. and has its own financing arm, is offering 3.99% mortgages to buyers.  The last time it had to offer home buyers such a deep discount was during the global financial crisis.  Profit margins have taken a hit from the rising cost of these incentives, so builders have decided to slow construction and wait for demand to recover.
